approval_context: Use two fresh in-host agent reviewers without inherited conversation for the blinded paired comparison; no new Jev or outside-provider requests.
source_model_identity: Not reported by the in-host agent runtime; no claim of different model identities.
equal_evidence: Every assisted packet, after removing only advice, equals its unaided packet. Both omit the same helpers. Case identifiers, questions, requirements, selected source text, and references match exactly.
advice_policy: Only original complete retained live results and assessments; no new calls, tuning, labels, author decisions, reports, or case origins were supplied.
separation: Both agents started with fork_turns=none. No reviewer decision was given to the other reviewer. Reviewer declarations are supported by distinct sessions, control-plane dispatch, packet inventories, and clock records; hashes alone do not prove blinding.
timing_validation: Each of 40 decisions matches its own original positive monotonic clock interval. Orders are complete; each session freezes after its final interval. Unaided bytes bind the assisted record, and unaided freeze precedes assisted first packet opening.
timing_comparability: Both include reasoning and tool latency and exclude setup and between-case gaps. The unaided timer ends before writing its decision; the assisted timer ends just after writing its initial decision. That small boundary difference remains a limitation.
serialization_correction: The coordinator initially shortened wrong_target to wrong in the assisted instructions. Four original labels are retained in classification_serialization and canonicalized without re-evaluation or timing changes.
limitations: One reviewer per condition; reviewer and order differences prevent causal attribution.
Measured agent elapsed time does not establish human active-review time.
Four correlated behavior families cannot establish production prevalence or threshold calibration.
